issue_request: FHIR-3260 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Questionnaire. It asked to remove the omitReason extension because reasons for not answering a question should be part of the questionnaire design, not captured as a reusable extension everywhere.
initial_application: Historical source commit 531674a735 removed the omitReason description from the old Questionnaire extension documentation. Later Questionnaire tracker commit 37ee370c54 added current guidance in source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml that a missing-answer reason should be captured using an explicit child item in the Questionnaire.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaire/list-Questionnaire-packs.xml references ImplementationGuide/Questionnaire-core, whose notes file contains the current guidance. Exact searches of current core source and the FHIR Extension Pack did not find an omitReason/omitreason/omit-reason extension definition. The only current core hit was a non-normative historical release-note line, and the Extension Pack questionnaireresponse-reason extension is a distinct concept about why a QuestionnaireResponse was created. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because build-scoped current source already implements the Jira decision.
